proposed_decisions: Symbol eta (modulus in thm:p15-w02b-p15-071-bias-variance) is distinct from eta^2 of def:p15-huber-joint-directional-constants; scoped locally.
K(t) in thm:p15-w02b-p15-071-pair-median-risk corresponds to H(t) of annex:p15.huber.pair.median, renamed to avoid the contaminant H.
vartheta is the source's mean-value fraction (p. 83); the source also uses vartheta for location on p. 82 in the interpretive sentence only.
V^*(q,varepsilon) is used for a general cutoff q; it is V^*(k,varepsilon) of thm:p15-huber-normal-variance, and W(q_1,varepsilon) in thm:p15-w02b-p15-071-prop1-population denotes the same function.
p_0 (edge-atom mass of the Proposal 1 window) parallels p of def:p15-huber-joint-directional-constants; C(k) at the normal law equals C there with S_0=1.
D_{(j)}(t) (ordered absolute residuals) is distinct from D_n (Glivenko-Cantelli sup distance); both appear in the annex.
